description: Get values for a metric (or all metrics) over an optional date range, with an aggregate (avg/sum/min/max/latest). The core data-retrieval tool. Every result carries a `coverage` block giving the metric's real firstDate/lastDate/days: check it before trusting a long window, and note that `aggregate` is always computed over the full range even when `points` are rolled up. Single-metric answers also list any logged point events inside the window as segmentBoundaries.

filterDays.description: Restrict to days covered by matching logged events (health-events.json): endDate ranges cover every day inclusive, point events cover their single day, negate:true keeps only days NOT covered. The answer states how many days matched. Example: HRV on night-shift blocks vs days off.

eventTag.description: Event tag to match, e.g. nights.

eventType.description: Event type to match, e.g. shift, medication, travel.

negate.description: Keep only days NOT covered by matching events.

granularity.description: Roll daily values up before returning them. 'auto' (default) picks the finest granularity that fits the response budget, so a multi-year range returns monthly points instead of thousands of daily ones.

limit.description: Maximum data points to return (default 365, max 3000). The server rolls up rather than truncating.

metric.description: Metric name, e.g. step_count, heart_rate, sleep_analysis. Omit for all.

name: get_health_metrics
